newsitem.title: USA: Conceptronic holders approve shr increase.
newsitem.headline: Conceptronic holders approve shr increase.

text.p: Conceptronic Inc said on Monday that its shareholders approved a plan on November 15 to increase the number of authorized shares to 15 million.
The shareholders also approved a proposal to increase the total number of shares of common stock available for the company's stock option plan to 625,000, Conceptronic said.
The company, which has about 1.4 million shares outstanding, was previously authorized to have 4 million shares of common stock, a company spokesman said.

The company is seeking $12,000,000 of equity capital to fund potential business acquisitions or other investments through a non-public offering of up to four million shares of its common stock at $3.00 a share, Conceptronic said.
